equity_bridge.item: Strategic investment portfolio at 70% of carrying value
equity_bridge.note: Long-term investments at FVTPL 85,343 less ~11,719 treasury investments already counted in cash = 73,624, plus equity-method associates 6,615 = 80,239 (interim balance sheet, 30 June 2026). Mostly Level 3 unlisted equity/preferred stakes in ecosystem companies plus listed stakes (listed associates fair value 3,671). Added because the fair-value gains and share of associate profits these produce are stripped from EBITDA (matching-asset rule); taken at a 30% haircut for Level-3 valuation uncertainty and illiquidity.

Interim Note 27: LP capital injected by third parties into the consolidated Hubei Xiaomi Yangtze River and Beijing Xiaomi Zhizao funds, carried at amortised cost approximating fair value. A minority claim on part of the portfolio above, so deducted in full.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-horizon base-case growth (FY2029-FY2032 ~4-5%) after a -5% FY2026 and a 6% rebound; neither the equity CAGR nor the revenue CAGR is a usable forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR (22.8%) exceeds revenue (17.7%) and is inflated by the March 2025 placing (~RMB40bn); EPS 3yr CAGR (153%) is off the FY2022 trough (EPS 0.10). FY2022-25 is a recovery from a collapse, not a trend: FY2025 revenue was +25% but H1 FY2026 is -8.4%.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest received). The 3-year figure is undefined because FY2022 owner FCF was -13,988; the 5-year figure (FY2020 15,473 -> FY2025 12,732) is -3.8% against +13.2% revenue growth: working-capital absorption (inventory for the EV ramp, fintech receivables) and rising SBC (2.3bn -> 5.4bn) have eaten the revenue growth. Reported FCF 5yr CAGR is +2.5%, so SBC and interest income are growing faster than cash flow.

scenario_narratives.base: Cyclical trough, partial recovery. FY2026 revenue -5% and cleaned EBITDA 9.5% as the memory-cost shock hits smartphone margins and the EV segment runs a loss; FY2027-28 revenue +6% and margins climb to 12.5% by FY2032 as memory normalises, EV reaches break-even then a mid-single-digit margin at 600k+ units, and internet services mix rises. Owner FCF margin 3% -> 6.4%; terminal at Gordon 10%/3%, under the 15x cap.
scenario_narratives.bull: Memory eases from Q3 FY2026, SkyNomad/new-gen SU7 take deliveries toward 550-600k, EV earns a high-single-digit margin by FY2030 with first overseas sales; smartphone premiumisation restores 12% GPM. Pre-SBC EBITDA 14.5%, FY2027-28 growth 10%, payables-funded growth captures 5% of incremental revenue.
scenario_narratives.bear: Memory upcycle into 2027 with no margin buffer; smartphone share erosion continues; EV stays loss-making through FY2028 under the price war and tax reinstatement; safety-regulation and recall costs. Growth -9% then ~3%, EBITDA 8.5-10%, WC consumption, 12x terminal cap.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Xiaomi is valued as a single owner-FCF stream from a hardware-plus-services operator in a cyclical trough, with the EV ramp's capital intensity inside the group capex path rather than carved out. Three deliberate conservatisms: FY0 EBITDA is cleaned of RMB11.8bn of investment fair-value gains; the strategic investment portfolio that produces those gains is added back only at 70% of carrying value, net of third-party fund capital; and the terminal multiple is capped at 15x (12x bear) for a business whose largest segment is a sub-5%-margin hardware line. Roughly a third of weighted value is the balance sheet (net cash + investments), which is what makes the bear case survivable; the rest rests on the EV segment earning a positive margin at scale, which it did for one year and then lost.
key_risks_to_valuation: EBITDA margin path: every 1pp of terminal pre-SBC EBITDA margin is worth roughly RMB3/share - the EV segment's margin at scale is the single driver the model cannot anchor to history
Memory-cost cycle duration: if DRAM/NAND pricing stays elevated through 2027 the FY2026-27 margins sit at the bear path, and the 5% hardware-margin pledge means Xiaomi cannot pass the cost through

Working capital: the FY2025 26bn inventory build and 2.1bn H1 FY2026 OCF show owner FCF can diverge from the component build by a year's worth of cash flow; wc_capture is 0 in base and the model is only right on average
Investment portfolio valuation: RMB80bn of mostly Level-3 stakes, modelled at 70%; a 20% write-down of the portfolio is ~RMB0.6/share
Currency: HKD values move one-for-one with CNYHKD; the rate (1.1724) is dated 2026-10-16 and is not refreshed by price-only refreshes
Regulatory tail: EV safety standards (2027/2029 door-release rules), assisted-driving liability and TSMC/US export controls on XRING silicon are binary risks sized only through the bear weight

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 1810.HK at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 21.30-48.14 HKD
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at the timestamp in inputs.fx_note
data_sources.financials: 1810.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics and kpis (FY2016-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2024-H1 FY2026 interim) built from the HKEX annual and interim reports; balance-sheet anchors read directly from 1810.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (balance sheet, Notes 15/21/23/27, cash-resources footnote 17, diluted-EPS note) and 1810.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (non-IFRS reconciliation, cash flow statement, lease note, capex table)
data_sources.qualitative: 1810.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17): segment commentary, EV delivery target and run-rate, memory-cost headwinds, buyback programme, regulatory developments

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 25,785.4m shares issued at 30 June 2026 (4,443.6m Class A + 21,341.8m Class B, interim Note 23) plus 703m dilutive RSUs/options (H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS table). The US$855m zero-coupon 2027 convertible (conversion price HK$36.74) is out of the money and anti-dilutive, so it is carried as debt in borrowings and NOT added to the count. Count held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; charging dilution as well would double-count. Post-June buybacks under the HK$20bn programme (~150m further shares to mid-August) reduce both the count and the cash pile and are ignored as value-neutral.
inputs.cash_note: Cash resources per the company's own definition at 30 June 2026 (interim footnote 17): cash and equivalents 37,252 + short-term term deposits 62,466 + long-term term deposits 65,711 + short-term investments at amortised cost 500 + short-term wealth-management products at FVTPL 21,506 + long-term investments at amortised cost 16,009 + treasury investments inside long-term FVTPL ~11,719 = 215,162 (RMB m). Restricted cash of 4,138 (largely fintech) is EXCLUDED for conservatism. The long-term term deposits are included because they are the asset earning the interest income stripped from the flows (matching-asset rule). Fintech loan receivables (13,090) are deliberately left out even though the factoring borrowings that fund part of them are in total_debt: their interest sits in internet-services revenue, so adding the asset would double-count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based compensation expenses (Note 28)' RMB5,365,075k (line 15829); identical to the non-IFRS reconciliation add-back. No cash taxes on net-share settlement are disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in kpis), so the combined figure equals the add-back.
inputs.interest_income_note: Cash 'Interest income received' FY2025 RMB3,276,391k (annual line 12772). Stripped because net cash (~176bn) is ~14x the owner-FCF base. Finance income on the P&L (5,381) is higher; the cash figure is used because the FCF base is a cash figure.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 'Payments for shares repurchase' RMB6,172,545k (annual line 12812); H1 FY2026 RMB9,685m and a new HK$20bn programme adopted May 2026. The flat count is therefore funded by an active repurchaser, not a modelling convention.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T19:09Z. Statements and all flows are RMB (interim report 'Expressed in RMB'); the 1810 counter quotes HKD. All per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by fx_rate to HKD; the unsuffixed intrinsic_value/weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price, with *_cny twins carrying the RMB basis. Parity check against the 81810 RMB counter on HKEX (same shares, settled in RMB): HK$26.66 / 1.1724 = RMB22.74 vs an observed 81810.HK print of RMB22.74 (Yahoo, 2026-10-16), a 0.0% tie that confirms the rate and its direction.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB, the currency of the flows: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + equity beta ~1.3 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~10.3% cost of equity; borrowings (39bn) are <7% of market capitalisation and cheap (2.9-4.1% USD notes, zero-coupon CB), so WACC rounds to 10.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality (memory cycle, China EV price war), regulatory and execution risk are charged in the flows and the scenario weights, not stacked into the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: the full IFRS-16 lease cash outflow (FY2025 principal 2,701 + interest 201 = RMB2,903m, 0.63% of revenue; H1 FY2026 1,407 = 0.68%) is charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path, and lease liabilities (RMB5.0bn: 3,440 non-current + 1,601 current) are EXCLUDED from total_debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (~RMB9.6bn of the 12.3bn total) so the lease is not charged twice. EBIT after this tie: 53,703 - 5,365 SBC - 2,903 lease - 9,557 D&A = 35,878 vs underlying FY2025 operating profit ex investment gains of 36,081 less lease interest 201.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI of RMB119m at 30 June 2026 is immaterial (<0.05% of equity) and ignored. The third-party LP capital in the consolidated Hubei/Beijing investment funds (RMB14,232m 'Liabilities to investors', interim Note 27) is the real minority claim and is deducted in the equity_bridge against the investment portfolio it part-funds.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon (FY2026-FY2035) because EV-segment margins are immature and the smartphone margin is at a cyclical trough. Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 (non-US operating company) with owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied: RMB WACC, dual currency, lease treatment B, matching-asset bridge. Xiaomi is a diversified consumer-electronics + smart-EV + internet-services operator; the EV segment's capital intensity is modelled inside the group capex path (company-definition capex RMB18.2bn FY2025 incl. EV/AI 12.0bn, vs the 12.8bn PP&E-only figure in the metrics table) rather than valued separately, because the segment shares the balance sheet, brand and channel. FY0 EBITDA IS CLEANED: FY2025 reported operating profit 47,901 includes 11,820 of net fair-value gains on investments (non-IFRS reconciliation, annual line ~1140); the model's ebitda_margin_path is pre-SBC, post-IFRS16 and EX those gains: (47,901 - 11,820) + 12,257 D&A + 5,365 SBC = 53,703 = 11.74% of revenue. H1 FY2026 on the same basis: (16,183 - 7,306 FV + 86 assoc... net 5,960 per reconciliation) -> ~19.4bn = 9.3%. Those excluded gains have their matching asset (the strategic investment portfolio) in equity_bridge. Working capital is modelled at 0% capture in base: payables (118bn) + customer advances (19bn) exceed receivables (20bn) + inventories (85bn), so growth is payables-funded, but FY2025 showed a 26bn inventory build and H1 FY2026 OCF was only 2.1bn; neutral is the honest base. Year-1 owner-FCF margin from the component build is ~3.3% (RMB14bn), against FY2025 actual owner FCF of 12.7bn (2.8%) and FY2024 of 24.6bn - consistent, not carrying a one-off forward. PRICE: HKEX regular close, not after-hours; stock is at the low end of its 52-week range after H1 FY2026 adjusted profit fell 43%.
inputs.owner_fcf_history_note: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest received: FY2020 15,473; FY2021 -649; FY2022 -13,988; FY2023 28,395; FY2024 24,626; FY2025 12,732 (RMB m). The series is dominated by working-capital swings (inventory, fintech receivables, factoring payables), which is why the forward build is component-based rather than margin-carried.

bear.narrative: The DRAM/NAND upcycle runs into 2027 and Xiaomi, with a 5% hardware-margin pledge and 9% smartphone GPM, has no buffer: shipments keep falling (Q2 FY2026 -26%), share slips below Transsion/OPPO in emerging markets. The China EV price war and the 2027 purchase-tax reinstatement keep the EV segment loss-making through FY2028 (RMB5-10bn/yr), the 550k target is missed by a third, and safety-regulation compliance (door-release standard, assisted-driving rules) adds cost and recall exposure. Group pre-SBC EBITDA stays 8.5-10%, growth consumes working capital (-5% capture), the terminal multiple is capped at 12x as for a hardware cyclical.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -5%: H1 was -8.4% (smartphone x AIoT -12.9% on memory-cost pricing and a 65m-unit half; EV +12.3%); H2 laps an already-weak H2 FY2025 (smartphone x AIoT 163.8bn) and gets the new-gen SU7/YU7/SkyNomad cadence, so the second half is roughly flat YoY. FY2027-28 +6%: memory cost normalises, EV deliveries grow from ~400k toward 550-600k with new body styles, internet services +8-10%. Then decelerates to 3% nominal RMB by FY2034 - the smartphone business is ex-growth and EV becomes a mature mid-single-digit grower.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 9.5% vs 9.3% in H1 (smartphone GPM 9.3%, EV segment loss 5.7bn in the half). Recovers to 12.5% by FY2032: smartphone GPM back to 11-12% as memory eases, EV segment back to break-even then a mid-single-digit operating margin at scale, internet services (76% GPM) mix rising. 12.5% pre-SBC is still below the FY2025 cleaned 11.7% + 1pp - a modest recovery, not a re-rating to peer EV margins. Capex 3.5% -> 2.8% (FY2025 4.0% was the EV/AI build peak; H1 FY2026 3.3%); D&A ex-ROU rises 2.2% -> 2.5% as that capex depreciates, so capex/D&A settles ~1.1x. Cash tax 17% -> 20%: FY2025 effective rate ex non-IFRS items ~17%, cash rate 13% on timing, Pillar-2 15% floor and a rising China-profit mix push it up.
base.narrative: Memory-cost shock is a two-year cyclical trough, not a structural break; EV returns to break-even in FY2027 and earns a mid-single-digit margin at 600k+ units; smartphone share stabilises at #3 globally. Owner FCF margin recovers from ~3% to ~6.4% by FY2035.

bull.narrative: Memory costs ease from Q3 FY2026 and the SkyNomad extended-range SUVs plus new-gen SU7 lift H2 deliveries toward the 550k run-rate; FY2027-28 EV grows 25-30% with first overseas sales from the Munich base, and the segment reaches a high-single-digit operating margin by FY2030. Smartphone premiumisation (ASP +16.5% in H1 FY2026, XRING silicon) holds share and restores 12%+ GPM; internet services compound with MAU. Group pre-SBC EBITDA reaches 14.5%, payables-funded growth adds 5% WC capture; the HK$20bn buyback retires ~5% of the count at these prices.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because BOTH core engines deteriorated at once in H1 FY2026 (adjusted profit -43%, smartphone GPM 9.3%, EV segment back to a RMB5.7bn loss) and the FY2026 EV target is tracking a third short - the downside is not a single-risk story. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right: memory normalising on schedule, EV re-accelerating against BYD/Leapmotor/XPeng in a shrinking China market, and smartphone share stabilising. Base 50%. The RMB176bn net cash plus the HK$20bn buyback bound the bear case well above zero, which is why bear is 30% and not higher.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
